paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Sifrei, Haazinu, on the verse 'How could one chase' [Deut. 32:30], and the reading of the Yalkut is R' Chananyah of Kfar Tiv'on.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Tibe’im and Kfar Tiv’on are transliterations, without place identification or common vocalization proof. Supplied טיבעים differs from machine מיבעים. Hyman reports a variant that changes both personal and place names, without deciding one versus two people. Both abbreviated personal titles remain R'.

Deuteronomy 32:30 is an editorial locator for the supplied verse opening איכה ירדוף. The earlier preserved note reports Miqra according to the Masorah’s איכה ירדף; no fresh check is claimed here. Sifrei and unspecified Yalkut passages remain uncollated, with no modern Midrash section inserted.
